## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; cyclicals (Energy, Materials, Industrials) are leading and sector breadth ≥7/11 confirms the call. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Top performers are Energy) — Value/Cyclical style.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: VLO (1W: +17.53% | 1M: +10.23%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +15.76% | 1M: +16.19%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +11.76% | 1M: +3.71%) ABOVE TREND. Materials and Industrials follow: DOW (1W: +10.86% | 1M: +13.39%) ABOVE TREND and EMR (1W: +8.39% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication, Utilities and Real Estate are lagging on the week: Communication weak with NFLX (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -6.47%) BELOW TREND; Utilities under pressure and Real Estate marginally negative. Technology shows internal rotation — strong pockets but key large caps underperform.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VLO (1W: +17.53% | 1M: +10.23%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +15.76% | 1M: +16.19%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +11.76% | 1M: +3.71%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +11.41% | 1M: +2.01%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +10.86% | 1M: +13.39%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership concentrated in Energy (Narrow).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ADBE (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -0.02%) BELOW TREND, KHC (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -6.47%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -5.71%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -16.95%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Tech names and staples.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W momentum: VLO (1W: +17.53%), SLB (1W: +15.76%), INTC (1W: +11.41%). MAJOR DIVERGENCE flagged: AIG (1W: -8.94% | 1M: +2.62%) TREND EXHAUSTION and JNJ (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +2.05%) TREND EXHAUSTION plus PFE (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -1.86%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — watch for trend breaks, tactical not core.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed rotation: chip-related names rallying — INTC (1W: +11.41% | 1M: +2.01%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +9.59% | 1M: +5.03%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +8.62% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND; large-cap software/hardware lag: AAPL (1W: -4.72% | 1M: -6.78%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -0.78% | 1M: -0.27%) BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive: JPM (1W: +2.81% | 1M: +5.10%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +7.33%) ABOVE TREND; idiosyncratic risk at AIG (1W: -8.94% | 1M: +2.62%) TREND EXHAUSTION.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Tentative strength but mixed headlines: UNH (1W: +5.07% | 1M: +7.18%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +2.05%) TREND EXHAUSTION — monitor headline-driven moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclical Value exposures: Energy (VLO, SLB, CVX), Materials (DOW) and select Financials (JPM) given breadth and leadership. Reduce exposure to lagging mega-cap Tech that remain BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT, AVGO) and monitor AIG/healthcare idiosyncrasies; major divergence suggests tactical caution.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: SLB (1W: +15.76% | 1M: +16.19%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +17.53% | 1M: +10.23%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +11.41% | 1M: +2.01%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AIG (1W: -8.94% | 1M: +2.62%) TREND EXHAUSTION, AAPL (1W: -4.72% | 1M: -6.78%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -16.95%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +7.85%), Materials (1W: +6.54%), Industrials (1W: +5.01%) — monitor follow-through. BEARISH: Communication (1W: -1.08%), Utilities (1W: -0.33%), Real Estate (1W: -0.14%) — watch for rotation into cyclicals.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch continuation in Energy (SLB/VLO) for follow-through above this week’s highs to validate RISK-ON continuation; monitor INTC/AMAT for confirmation of chip strength as tech leadership breadth signal. Watch AAPL to hold recent support (BELOW TREND) and AIG to stabilize above its 1M trend to remove exhaustion risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
SLB (+60): SLB (1W: +15.76% | 1M: +16.19%) ABOVE TREND — bullish news (Aramco win) confirming price strength. CVX (+50): CVX (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +7.09%) ABOVE TREND — analyst lift confirming rally. F (+50): F (1W: +9.76% | 1M: +9.59%) ABOVE TREND — upgrade-driven move confirming accumulation. NVDA (+50): NVDA (1W: -0.78% | 1M: -0.27%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines but price not confirming (divergence).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AIG (-60): AIG (1W: -8.94% | 1M: +2.62%) TREND EXHAUSTION — bearish news confirmed by heavy weekly drop. JNJ (-50): JNJ (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +2.05%) TREND EXHAUSTION — policy headlines creating risk despite 1M strength. WMT (-50): WMT (1W: +1.49% | 1M: -0.23%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — legal headlines are divergent vs short-term uptick; monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a Value/Cyclical style. SLB (1W: +15.76% | 1M: +16.19%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +17.53% | 1M: +10.23%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +2.81% | 1M: +5.10%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is a MAJOR DIVERGENCE in select names (AIG, JNJ, PFE) and bullish NVDA headlines not yet confirmed by price — monitor for trend breaks.
